Tours.title: Tours
Tours.description: Content, prices, itinerary and publishing for each tour. Only an admin edits prices and terms.
Tours.createHint: Create a draft with the key facts; fill in the rest in the editor.
Tours.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and hyphens, for example VN-HLB-03. Shown to customers and on bookings.
Tours.duplicateBody: The copy keeps content, images, destinations and styles, has no departures, is a draft and has no published language.
Tours.pricesReadOnly: Only an MFA-verified admin edits prices and terms.
Tours.fromPriceHint: Used for private tours and before departures exist.
Tours.ogImageHint: Leave empty to use the hero image.
Tours.subtitle: Subtitle
Tours.summaryHint: Two or three sentences for tour cards and search results.
Tours.question: Question {index}
Tours.publishRules: A published tour needs at least one published language, a hero image with Vietnamese and English alt text, and a price (a departure for group tours, a from price for private tours).
Tours.activeDepartures: {count, plural, =0 {No departures yet} one {# open departure} other {# open departures}}

errors.codeInvalid: Only capital letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.code_taken: This tour code is already used.
errors.maxBelowMin: The maximum must be at least the minimum.
errors.infantAge: The infant age must be below the child age.
errors.publishNeedsTranslation: At least one language must be published.
errors.publishNeedsHero: A hero image with Vietnamese and English alt text is needed.
errors.publishNeedsPrice: A private tour needs a from price above 0 before publishing.
errors.publishNeedsDeparture: A group tour needs at least one departure before publishing.
errors.lastTranslation: The last published language of a published tour cannot be unpublished. Set the tour to draft first.
errors.adminOnly: Only an admin edits prices and terms.
errors.keepLanguage: A whole language cannot be removed by clearing the tour title. Keep the title, or unpublish this language.
errors.dayImageAlt: A day photo needs Vietnamese and English alt text before this language is published.
